jobs.title: Head of Global HR Analytics & Data Office
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 274279

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Head of Global HR Analytics and Data Office leads and oversees a team comprised of the global data office; analytics and insights; advanced analytics capabilities; reporting and visualization; and AI. This role is the primary contact for all matters related to Global Human Resources data and is the champion for advancing analytics capabilities, technologies, human capital insights and a culture of data literacy.

As the Global Human Resources Data leader, this position oversees the data office and manages the design, development and implementation of data strategies; data standards; data products; data procedures; data governance; and data security all in alignment with the Bank’s data governance framework. This role is also accountable for developing and driving our advanced people analytics capabilities and to create data and analytics assets while advancing our behavioral science reach.

A key aspect of this role is to provide the experience and thought leadership to evolve our data strategy roadmap to achieve a consolidated and consistent global view of data across multiple systems and geographies. They will provide oversight and support for applied employee research, data mining, advanced analytics, and the development of predictive models to further our understanding of the workforce and improve employee experience.

This position is responsible for the production of all monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad-hoc human capital reporting requests and ensures the accuracy, comprehensiveness and timeliness of the data provided. Driving continuous improvement of self-serve and visualization capabilities is paramount in order to optimize user experience and adoption. They will also provide subject matter expertise and point of view on how to advance our technology capabilities such as AI, machine learning, large language models, and cloud-based tools.

Is this role right for you? In this role, you will:

Lead the transformation of Global HR’s data, analytics, reporting and visualization capabilities to improve data-driven decision making and accelerate insights at scale to help each line of business optimize human capital.
Drive applied employee research, data mining, analytical/statistical methodology, behavioral science and the development of predictive models to further our understanding of the workforce and enhance employee experience.
Lead advanced analytics to drive actionable insights to propel human capital decision making and build behavioral science capabilities to enhance employee understanding and awareness.
Partner closely with IT to develop data engineering pipelines, advance technology capabilities (i.e., software, infrastructure and data pipelines) to better leverage AI, machine learning and cloud-based tools.
Develop a programmatic approach to increase data literacy and adoption across Global Human Resources in order to enhance advice capabilities and to deliver impactful human capital insights for each line of business.
Manage the design, development and implementation of data strategies, data standards, data procedures, data governance and data security to support Global Human Resources and ensure alignment with the Bank’s Data Governance Framework.
Establish data quality rules, standards and thresholds and ensure appropriate data quality monitoring practices are in place; lead the identification and root-cause analysis of data quality issues and support remediation efforts in a timely manner based on priority.
Develop teams and create a high performing culture that nurtures talent and helps bring to life our values of collaboration, growth, and respect.
Manage direct reports and the broader department to achieve organizational goals in accordance with company policies and practices.
Create an effective work environment by developing a common vision, setting clear objectives, expecting teamwork, recognizing outstanding performance, maintaining open communications and encourage high level of engagement across the team.
Build a high-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviors; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.
Create an environment in which the team pursues effective and efficient operations of the respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values and Code of Conduct, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed? We’d love to work with you if you have:

Post-Secondary degree in a quantitative /computer science /data & analytics field. Relevant Master’s Degree is desirable. A minimum of seven or more years of progressive, relevant and practical experience in people analytics and data management; a proven track record of success in analytical reporting and the implementation/management of supporting technology systems.
Expert understanding of data management structure, big data, business requirements, analytics, reporting delivery – incl Enterprise Data Lake, database management & technology reporting tools (PowerBI) and coding languages.
Experienced in leading applied employee research and knowledge of behavioral science and industrial/organizational psychology.
Excellent knowledge of Statistics (SAS, SPSS), Data Mining (MS SQL), Business Intelligence and Office Automation software packages including good knowledge of computer languages.
Strong project management skills with a proven ability to work independently and proactively to drive data management and analytics efforts.
Leadership and communication skills required to manage, prioritize and execute diverse activities and projects concurrently. Also, collaborative leadership skills to drive people development and strong team growth.
Integrity, high attention to detail, thoroughness, and accuracy are critical to ensure quality outputs. Solid organizational interpersonal and communication skills and be able to direct varied activities within tight time frames.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills are essential in dealing with many senior internal and external parties, as well as preparing reports for Executive Management.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

jobs.title: Finance Director
jobs.description:
Location: Toronto- Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

Yonge-Eglinton

Department: Finance

Status: Full-Time Permanent

Salary Range: $150,000-$160,000 annually, based on experience

This role supports the healthcare brands across the FH Health portfolio (Pollin Fertility, Perennial and Wellness Haus). FH Health was founded by tech entrepreneurs to support Canada’s pandemic response with innovative healthcare solutions. We’ve since evolved into a leading health-tech company that transforms traditional clinic experiences by integrating diagnostics and care through technology. We are proud to support a portfolio of healthcare brands:

Pollin Fertility-A next-generation fertility centre revolutionizing patient experience, safety, and outcomes through advanced technology.
Perennial – Integrated primary and wellness care brought directly to retirement residences, improving seniors' health and quality of life.
Wellness Haus – A physician-led clinic blending evidence-based medicine with cutting-edge wellness care.

Learn more:
www.fhhealth.com
www.pollinfertility.com
www.perennialcare.ca

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Director of Finance to lead and scale our finance function and support the growth and expansion of the business. This role will serve as a key member of the leadership team, partnering closely with the executive team to drive financial performance, support growth initiatives, and shape the company’s long-term strategy. This role will also champion process improvements, automation, and the adoption of modern financial technologies, including AI-driven tools, to transform and elevate the finance function. The successful candidate will bring a forward-thinking, digitally savvy approach to optimizing workflows, enhancing reporting, and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.The ideal candidate is a designated CPA with strong analytical capabilities and a proven track record of building high-performing teams, optimizing financial operations, and enabling data-driven decision-making in a high-growth environment.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Strategy
Act as a strategic advisor to the executive team on financial planning, growth, and expansion initiatives
Lead the development of long-term financial strategy aligned with corporate objectives
Translate business strategy into actionable financial plans and performance metrics
Support capital planning, fundraising, and investor relations as needed

Financial Planning & Analysis
Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling across all business units
Review financial results and identify key drivers, risks, and opportunities
Develop insights on profitability levers, cost optimization, and revenue growth
Establish KPIs and dashboards to enable real-time, data-driven decision-making
Partner with operations and clinical leaders to align financial and business strategies

Financial Reporting & Controls
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes
Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial statements in accordance with ASPE
Strengthen internal controls, policies, and financial governance frameworks
Lead audit processes, tax compliance, and coordination with external advisors
Accounting & Finance OperationsProvide oversight of day-to-day accounting operations, including A/R, A/P, payroll, inventory management and treasury
Drive process improvements, automation, and scalability across finance functions by leveraging modern technologies, including AI, to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and insight generation
Ensure compliance with regulatory, tax, and payroll requirements
Oversee financial operations across a multi-entity organizational structure

Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
Build and scale the finance function to support company growth and expansion
Promote cross-functional collaboration across departments
Act as a change agent to reimagine and modernize the finance function from the ground up, delivering strategic insights and building a nimble, high-impact team

Qualifications

CPA designation (required) in good standing
8–12+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including leadership roles
Experience in healthcare, technology, or high-growth environments
Strong background in financial planning & analysis, reporting, and operational finance
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives
Experience with ERP systems (preferably Odoo) and financial reporting tools
Deep understanding of ASPE and IFRS standards
Exceptional analytical, communication, and leadership skills
Hands-on, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment

Why Join FH Health (Perennial, Pollin and Wellness Haus)?

You’ll be joining a mission-driven, fast-growing organization that’s reimagining healthcare with innovation at its core. This is a unique opportunity to play a leadership role in shaping the financial future of a company making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

Apply Now

We look forward to learning more about you. If you're a strategic finance leader passionate about driving growth and innovation in healthcare, we encourage you to apply.

FH Health is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact careteam@perennialcare.ca for assistance.We thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director, Platform Product Owner
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 274773

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Team

Global Wealth Banking and Markets Engineering (GWBMT) is the fast-moving, award-winning technology engine that powers Scotiabank's Wealth and Capital Markets businesses.

The Platform Engineering organization provides the foundational technology platforms and cloud services that enable application teams to innovate rapidly, securely, and at scale. Our portfolio includes enterprise Kubernetes platforms spanning on-premises and Google Cloud environments, Cloud Enablement Services, Kafka as a Service, Airflow as a Service, Fine-Grained Access Management capabilities, and future developer platform offerings that accelerate application modernization and cloud adoption.

The Role

We are seeking a Director Platform Product Owner to lead the product strategy, roadmap, adoption, and delivery of a portfolio of enterprise platform products that serve hundreds of engineers and mission-critical applications across the bank.

This role sits at the intersection of technology, product management, engineering, and business strategy. The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and evolving platform products that enable cloud adoption, application modernization, developer productivity, security, and operational excellence.

As a senior product leader, you will partner closely with Platform Engineering, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and application development teams to ensure our platforms deliver measurable business value, exceptional user experiences, and scalable solutions that meet the needs of a rapidly evolving enterprise landscape.

You will act as the voice of the engineering customer while balancing engineering priorities, platform sustainability, risk management, and strategic technology objectives.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Product Strategy & Portfolio Leadership
Define and execute the strategic vision, roadmap, and lifecycle management of a portfolio of platform engineering products and services.
Develop product strategies that accelerate cloud adoption, platform standardization, application modernization, and engineering productivity.
Identify emerging customer needs and market trends to drive innovation and platform evolution.
Establish product success metrics, adoption goals, customer satisfaction targets, and business outcomes.
Prioritize investments and roadmap initiatives based on business value, engineering impact, risk reduction, and operational efficiency.

Product Portfolio Includes

Enterprise Kubernetes Platforms (On-Prem and Google Cloud)
Cloud Enablement and Migration Services
Airflow as a Service
Kafka as a Service
Fine-Grained Access Management Platforms
Developer Platform Capabilities and Self-Service Engineering Solutions
Customer Engagement & Platform Adoption
Act as the primary advocate for platform consumers across GBM and enterprise engineering teams.
Build deep understanding of customer journeys, pain points, and platform adoption barriers.
Drive platform onboarding strategies and self-service experiences that improve developer productivity.
Partner with application teams to identify modernization opportunities and accelerate cloud migration initiatives.
Lead customer advisory forums, feedback programs, and adoption reviews to continually improve platform offerings.
Establish product analytics frameworks and measurable indicators to track platform utilization, customer outcomes, productivity gains, and business value realization.
Technical Product Ownership
Translate strategic objectives into clear product roadmaps, capabilities, requirements, and delivery plans.
Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to define platform capabilities, service offerings, APIs, and user experiences.
Ensure platform products align with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and regulatory obligations.
Define service offerings, operating models, support models, and service-level objectives (SLOs) for platform products.
Champion platform engineering principles, self-service capabilities, automation, and developer experience improvements.
Establish service consumption metrics, cost transparency models, showback/chargeback capabilities, and platform ROI measures.
Delivery Leadership & Execution
Lead the planning and execution of platform product initiatives from ideation through delivery and adoption.
Partner with engineering leaders to balance feature development, platform reliability, technical debt reduction, and operational excellence.
Drive agile product delivery practices, roadmap governance, backlog prioritization, and release planning.
Track delivery performance and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives across multiple platform teams.
Manage dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations across a complex enterprise environment.
Platform Reliability, Security & Operational Excellence
Define and monitor key platform performance indicators, including availability, reliability, scalability, security, adoption, and customer satisfaction.
Partner with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and Operations teams to improve platform resiliency and operational maturity.
Ensure security controls, access governance, and compliance requirements are embedded within platform services.
Drive continual improvement initiatives focused on automation, observability, service health, and cost optimization.
Balance innovation with operational stability and risk management.
Own the end-to-end platform user experience across onboarding, self-service workflows, documentation, observability, support engagement, and lifecycle management.
Stakeholder Management & Executive Communication
Build strong relationships with senior technology leaders, architects, engineering teams, security stakeholders, and business partners.
Present product strategy, investment priorities, roadmap progress, and platform value realization to executive leadership.
Influence strategic technology decisions across cloud, platform engineering, developer experience, and modernization initiatives.
Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:

10+ years of technology experience with at least 5 years in Product Management, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Developer Platforms, or Infrastructure Services.
Proven experience leading the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of large-scale platform products.
Experience working with cloud platforms, enterprise infrastructure, and application modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of platform engineering, developer experience, self-service platforms, and product operating models.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across multiple organizations.
Experience leading cross-functional teams in complex enterprise environments.
Outstanding communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
Strong strategic thinking, prioritization, and data-driven decision-making capabilities.

Technical Expertise

Strong understanding of Kubernetes and container platforms operating across hybrid-cloud environments.
Experience with public cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Familiarity with event-driven architectures, Kafka, streaming platforms, and modern data infrastructure.
Understanding of workflow orchestration and data engineering platforms such as Apache Airflow.
Knowledge of Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Fine-Grained Authorization, and Zero Trust security principles.
Experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, platform automation, observability, and reliability engineering practices.
Understanding of platform security, risk management, compliance, and operational resilience requirements.

Preferred

Experience building or managing Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and self-service engineering ecosystems.
Background in Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Architecture, or Software Engineering.
Experience driving enterprise cloud transformation and migration programs.
Experience within financial services, capital markets, or other highly regulated industries.
Knowledge of Google Cloud technologies including GKE, networking, observability, and security services.

Success Measures

Success In This Role Will Be Measured By

Platform adoption and customer satisfaction
Growth of cloud-enabled and modernized applications
Developer productivity improvements and self-service adoption
Reliability, availability, and operational performance of platform services
Reduction in onboarding friction and time-to-market
Delivery of strategic roadmap commitments
Platform cost optimization and operational efficiency
Achievement of security, compliance, and risk management objectives

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove, and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days, and benefits will start on day one.
Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. jobs.title: Director Financial Reporting (Mat Leave Coverage)
jobs.description:
At Varicent, We’re Not Just Transforming The Sales Performance Management (SPM) Market—we’re Redefining How Organizations Achieve Revenue Success. Our Cutting-edge SaaS Solutions Empower Revenue Leaders Globally To Design Smarter Go-to-market Strategies, Maximize Seller Performance, And Unlock Untapped Potential. Varicent Stands At The Forefront Of Innovation, Celebrated As a Market Leader In The 2025 Forrester Wave Report For SPM, 2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index, Gartner Peer Insights, 2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide, And G2. Our Solutions Are Trusted By a Diverse Range Of Global Industry Leaders Like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker And Hundreds More. Here’s Why You’ll Thrive At Varicent

Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide.
Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team.
Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization.
Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment.

Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

The Opportunity

This is an 18-month fixed-term position covering a maternity leave. The Director, Financial Reporting, reporting to the Vice President of Finance, is a key member of the Finance department and owns the global financial close, consolidation, external financial reporting, and audit execution; and partners with internal stakeholders and external advisors on global tax compliance and planning. They are an experienced Controller/Director with extensive knowledge of accounting principles, systems and processes, and a passion for partnering with key stakeholders to drive awareness and optimization of the business. They are enthusiastic, high-energy, an experienced people leader, and passionate about coaching and investing in their team to elevate career development and experience.

This is a hands-on role in a high-growth software business backed by U.S. Private Equity. This role will partner with other senior leaders to continue to build and scale the department with best practices to support our global business with operations in Canada, US, UK, Romania and Australia.

What You'll Do

Financial Accounting and Reporting: Oversee the ongoing accounting function and financial reporting calendar to meet critical reporting timelines. Be the in-house technical accounting expert that ensures compliance with US GAAP (ASC 606 revenue recognition, ASC 718 stock based compensation, ASC 842 leases, etc), federal, state and local laws and accounting principles in the US, Canada, UK, LATAM, Romania, and Australia.
Audit Management: Manage the relationships with external auditors and government authorities. Effectively negotiate and defend the Company's accounting positions and manage audits to be on time and on budget. Prepare complex technical accounting and tax memos, working papers, and consolidated financial statements with note disclosures in compliance with US GAAP.
Tax: Participate in global tax planning and strategy (transfer pricing, SR&ED) and coordinate tax return compliance and preparation with our global tax advisors. Oversee sales tax compliance and follow-ups.
Collaborate with FP&A to support internal and external management reporting: Produce high-quality monthly, quarterly and annual consolidated financial statements, MD&A and management reports; provide thorough analysis of the financial data and effectively communicate key findings, opportunities and risk.
Lead AI-enabled finance automation across close, reconciliations, variance analysis, reporting, and audit support by integrating our tech stack (NetSuite, Concur, Salesforce, Adaptive Planning, UKG, Snowflake, and Claude) in partnership with AI/Systems, ensuring strong controls, data security, and documentation.
Support the sales process through delivering financial health reviews on customer calls.
People Leader, Coach & Active Listener: Lead a team responsible for accounting, audit management, financial reporting and tax. Lead their training and development, performance evaluation and maintaining a healthy and collaborative work environment.

What You’ll Bring

CPA + experience at a top tier accounting firm + industry experience.
8 years' experience leading global accounting operations as a Controller/Director.
4 years of people management experience.
Advanced knowledge of US GAAP/IFRS.
Proficiency with NetSuite or similar ERP systems.
Experience preparing consolidated financial statements and note disclosures and managing auditors and government agencies.
Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to drive results.
Egoless, Innovative and Entrepreneurial: Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Relentless focus on improvement and raising the bar. Balances scrappiness and execution with business maturity, prioritization, and thoughtfulness. Is curious, agile, a self-starter and welcomes challenge as a conduit to improvement. Can be creative with resources and has a history of getting things done in complex environments and flat hierarchies. Welcomes candor from above and below.
Collaborative: Will have the confidence and willingness to work up and down the organization.
Effective Communication Skills: High integrity, no-nonsense approach. Quick and to the point. An active listener.

For this role, the estimated annual base salary range is between CAD $138,200.00 - $181,400.00
. In addition to base salary, our compensation package may include bonuses, commissions for eligible sales roles, and a comprehensive benefits package. The actual base salary will vary based on factors including individual qualifications and market data, as objectively assessed during the interview process.

This posting is for an existing
vacancy.

This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement — not replace — human decision-making.

Overview Of Benefits

Health & Wellness— Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage tailored to your local needs
Time Off— PTO and public holidays to rest, recharge, and do what matters most
Volunteer Days— Dedicated time to give back and support the communities that matter to you
Ignite Days— Dedicated learning days to support continuous growth, skill development, and professional learning
Financial— Compensation that reflects your market and your value
Retirement— Retirement plans designed to help you build long-term financial security
Tuition Assistance— Invest in your growth with support for continuing education and professional development
Flexibility— Work where you thrive, with remote and hybrid options available across most regions

Varicent is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process please email accomodations@varicent.com

Varicent is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.
